user.title: Hisense AEH-W4E1
user.description: Choose how to set up your air conditioner. One configuration entry is created per air conditioner — repeat the setup for each unit. The LAN key (lanip_key) is required: fetch it once via the cloud method.

manual.title: Manual setup (fully local)
manual.description: Enter the AC's static IP and its LAN key. The LAN key can be obtained once via the cloud method.

data.name: Name
data.temp_unit: Temperature unit reported by the device

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the air conditioner
reconfigure.description: Update the device address or LAN key (for example after a router change or if the module was re-provisioned to a new app account).

data.name: Name
data.temp_unit: Temperature unit reported by the device

cloud.title: Cloud discovery (one-time)
cloud.description: Sign in once with your OEM app credentials to fetch the device list and LAN keys. After setup the integration works fully locally; you can block the A/Cs from the internet.

cloud_device.title: Select the air conditioner
cloud_device.description: One configuration entry is created per air conditioner. Pick one now; to add the others, repeat *Add Integration* → *Hisense AEH-W4E1* → *Cloud* with the same credentials and choose the next device.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the air conditioner (check the IP address)
error.invalid_key_id: The LAN key ID must be a number

abort.already_configured: This air conditioner is already configured
abort.no_lan_ip: The device has no local IP assigned; connect it to the network first

init.title: AEH-W4E1 options
init.description: Local server, polling and network scanning options.

data.server_port: LAN server port (0 = system-assigned free port, recommended)
data.local_ip: IP address advertised to the ACs (empty = auto-detect; set it when HA is on a different subnet/VLAN)
data.scan_network: Network for targeted scans: rediscovery of unreachable modules and the scan service (CIDR, empty = inferred)

unknown_key_id.title: Unknown AEH-W4E1 module tried to connect
unknown_key_id.description: A module at {ip} performed a key exchange with LAN key id {key_id}, which does not match any configured air conditioner. If this is a new unit, add it from the integration page. If a configured unit was re-provisioned to another app account, reconfigure it with the new LAN key.

port_bind_failed.title: AEH-W4E1 LAN server port conflict
port_bind_failed.description: Port {port} could not be bound ({error}). Open the integration options and set the LAN server port to 0 (system-assigned free port, recommended) or to another unused port.

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Sends a raw property command to one or more AEH-W4E1 air conditioners.

request_status_refresh.name: Request status refresh
request_status_refresh.description: Queues a full status poll for one or more AEH-W4E1 air conditioners; the device reports back as soon as it next connects.

scan_network.name: Scan network
scan_network.description: Probes the local subnet for Ayla modules and fires an `aeh_w4e1_scan_completed` event with the results.
